rows.grounds: introductory particle marking transition to a new topic
verb of speaking introducing the forthcoming teaching
genitive indicating the deity or planet to whom the mantra belongs
compound qualifying the mantra as greatly marvelous

items.question: Which wondrous alternative mantra is taught for the planet Mars?
premises: The speaker introduces a new topic.
An alternative mantra is to be declared.
This mantra belongs to Mars and is very wondrous.
items.inference: Therefore, a wondrous alternative mantra of Mars will be taught.
items.plain_english: Now I shall declare another very wondrous mantra of Mars.
